process_name: Plasmid DNA Drug Substance - E. coli Fermentation & AEX Downstream Process
modality: Plasmid DNA (pDNA) for gene therapy / vaccine applications

unit_operations.name: Seed Train Expansion
unit_operations.description: Glycerol stock to shake flask to 5 L seed fermenter, antibiotic-free selective medium.

unit_operations.name: Production Fermentation (Fed-Batch)
unit_operations.description: 100 L fed-batch fermentation to high cell density, non-antibiotic plasmid maintenance system.

unit_operations.name: Cell Harvest (Centrifugation)
unit_operations.description: Continuous centrifugation to pellet cells for alkaline lysis.

unit_operations.name: Alkaline Lysis & Neutralization
unit_operations.description: NaOH/SDS lysis followed by potassium acetate neutralization to precipitate genomic DNA and protein.

unit_operations.name: Clarification (Depth Filtration)
unit_operations.description: Depth filtration to remove precipitated gDNA/protein/cell debris flocs.

unit_operations.name: Endotoxin/RNA Reduction (Selective Precipitation)
unit_operations.description: Calcium chloride precipitation step to reduce residual RNA and endotoxin ahead of chromatography.

unit_operations.name: Anion Exchange Capture Chromatography
unit_operations.description: AEX bind-elute step, resolving supercoiled plasmid from open-circular/linear isoforms and RNA.

unit_operations.name: Size-Exclusion / Hydrophobic Polish
unit_operations.description: Polish step to further enrich supercoiled topology and remove residual HCP/endotoxin.

unit_operations.name: Tangential Flow Filtration (Concentration/Diafiltration)
unit_operations.description: TFF to concentrate and exchange into final formulation buffer (TE or saline).

unit_operations.name: Sterile Filtration & Fill
unit_operations.description: 0.2 um sterile filtration into final bulk containers.
